notes: Posted 7 August 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

No starting section is posted. The Objective is listed under Objective (1); Podrace Prep (posted under Interrupts) is the starting Interrupt per the strategy ('You use podrace prep to get out squadron assingments and all the podrace stuff'), and Squadron Assignments (posted under Effects) is the Effect it deploys. All count toward the 60.

The Interrupts header says 22 but the listed Interrupts total 20; the strategy says '-1 Rebel Barrier, -1 It Could Be Worse' were cut. The listed quantities (2 Rebel Barrier, 3 It Could Be Worse) total 60 and are kept as published.
